description: Verify that TCP in FIN-WAIT-1 honours RECEIVE calls and ACKs incoming data while remaining in FIN-WAIT-1 (RFC 793 §3.5 p38)
approach:
[Objective]
FW1 means DUT has CLOSE'd but the peer hasn't ACK'd yet. The half-open direction is still readable: incoming data must be acked + buffered, no premature transition to other states.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake; user CLOSE → DUT in FW1.
2. Tester → DUT: data segment.
3. Observation: DUT acks the data + RECEIVE call returns it; no RST.

[Pass condition]
DUT acks data + reports correct payload + remains in FW1.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack / Fail_no_dut_fin — prelude broken
• Fail_no_dut_data_ack — DUT did not ACK in FW1
• Fail_dut_rst_in_fw1 — DUT mistakenly emitted RST
• Fail_no_proper_data — wrong payload reported

verdicts.Pass: DUT acked data and read it in FIN-WAIT-1 — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_dut_data_ack: No DUT ACK to received data in FW1
verdicts.Fail_no_proper_data: DUT did not receive proper data in FW1
